acceptance_condition: Satisfy every assigned whole-task demand and explicit constraint.
rationale: The whole task submitted after intake.
text: Write a 2,000–2,600 word research note that develops and defends a new mechanistic answer to this question: under a matched inference-compute budget, when should staged, retrieval-mediated question/answer communication among language-model agents outperform both independent sampling with final aggregation and an open shared transcript? Use the supplied seven-paper corpus as evidence, but do not merely survey it. Reconcile its conflicting empirical findings; formulate an explicit causal model of information diversity, social influence, retrieval, and synthesis; derive at least four discriminating predictions that separate your mechanism from plausible alternatives; identify what the existing literature cannot identify; and give a preregisterable experiment with conditions, randomization, estimands, power-analysis inputs, failure criteria, and an analysis plan. End with the strongest warranted conclusion and the observation most likely to falsify it.
